newsitem.title: GERMANY: Zeitler-Buba doesn't want strong reversal of dlr.
newsitem.headline: Zeitler-Buba doesn't want strong reversal of dlr.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Franz Christoph Zeitler said on Thursday that the central bank did not want to see an overshoot reversal of the dollar's recent upward correction versus the mark.

Asked about the dollar's appreciation against the mark this year, Zeitler said that the Group of Seven (G7) meeting at the end of April had determined that state of correction in the exchange rates had "more or less" come to an end.
"On the other hand, what we do not want is a push in the other direction," Zeitler told reporters after a Bundesbank news conference.

The mark has depreciated sharply against the dollar this year. It was trading at 1.7620 to the dollar just before the start of the Bundesbank's news conference, but had gained to 1.7540 to the dollar at 1100 GMT.
Zeitler added that the Bundesbank had always wanted a strong mark which would then translate into a strong euro.
